item.title: Investigation: Alice Huang had ties to gaming firms, alleged Prince Group figures and hundreds of shell companies in a network moving Nvidia chips to China (Financial Times)
item.description:
Financial Times:
Investigation: Alice Huang had ties to gaming firms, alleged Prince Group figures and hundreds of shell companies in a network moving Nvidia chips to China  —  Chinese executive in romantic relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had connections to the lucrative trade moving chips to China

item.title: Rhodium: China's biggest tech companies are set to double capex to $139B in 2026 with AI lab revenue under 8% of it, a gap that may matter more than chip curbs (New York Times)
item.description:
New York Times:
Rhodium: China's biggest tech companies are set to double capex to $139B in 2026 with AI lab revenue under 8% of it, a gap that may matter more than chip curbs  —  While Anthropic and other Silicon Valley A.I. giants are raising tens of billions in capital, Chinese rivals are struggling to keep pace financially.
